title: devwork · tasks/<id>/mission-<ws>.md — one mission from HQ to the Obra, frontmatter only. The body follows scaffolds/mission.md: QUESTION, READ, ESTABLISHED FACTS, OUT OF SCOPE, WRITE, RETURN.
description: advisor-lab-20261013 FR-001, 2026-10-13. Generalized from the TASK-15993 mission prompts (prompt-ws1.md, prompt-ws3.md, 2026-10-12): one workstream, one question, one output file, an established block. The mission lives in the folder of the Earth task that owns it.

workstream.description: WS<n> for a question, T<n> for a node of the task's plan.md graph

agent.description: Obra agent for --agent (builder, qa-gate, scout, archaeologist, web-researcher); absent = the main session

model.description: --model alias; for a T<n> mission, the node's tier. obra refuses a mission without it

effort.description: --effort; obra refuses a mission without it

advisor.description: --advisor model, only when the task needs one; the body must say when to consult it (ticket-1441 logbook 42)

tools.description: optional --allowedTools pre-approvals for commands the Obra's auto mode cannot check in advance (a pipe through tee); the flag never restricts, the Obra's settings.json bounds the run (ticket-1441 logbook 43)

task_id.description: the Earth task that owns the mission, e.g. TASK-15993

oneOf.description: the mission writes only its output and its return event
absolute paths the mission may write besides its output

output.description: ONE absolute output file, inside the task folder

established.description: facts already settled: do not re-derive, contradict only with a cited line

ledger.description: the task ledger that receives the return event
